author: yassinyl
description: MotionEye is an open-source video surveillance application that manages webcams easily with a graphical interface.

tips.before_install:
MotionEye requires a webcam or IP camera to be connected to function properly. 
If you use USB cameras, you can add their paths (like /dev/video0) in the settings after installation.
After installation, access the web interface at: 
http://your_server_ip:8765
